Dit is die kern van gesonde dissipelskap: presies wat ons moet soek en koester in dié wat vir ons dissipels maak, en presies waartoe ons self geroep word sodra ons ander begin dissipel. Teks: 1 Thessalonisense 2:1–12 (AFR2020) Prediker:

episodes.title: 381. Heilig in Hoop (1): "Tekens van Lewe"
episodes.desc: Paulus weet sonder twyfel dat die Thessalonisense uitverkies is — nie omdat hy raai nie, maar omdat hy dit sien: 'n vrug wat in hulle lewe werk, en 'n voorbeeld wat na buite uitstraal. Dít is waarop ons bou, nie ons eie gevoelens of aannames nie. Teks: Handelinge 17:1-15 & 1 Thessalonisense 1 (AFR2020) Prediker: Johan Verster Datum: 16 Augustus 2026

episodes.title: 380. Koninkrykskultuur (3): "Gebed vir Geseëndes"
episodes.desc: Psalm 67 roep ons op om vir God se seën te bid, sodat die nasies Sy verlossing kan ken, hulle in Sy heerskappy kan verbly, en Sy Naam kan verheerlik. Teks: Psalm 67 (ESV) Prediker: Eloff van Niekerk Datum: 12 Augustus 2026 *Neem kennis dat die eerste deel van die preek as gevolg van 'n kragonderbreking nie opgeneem het nie.

episodes.title: 379. Koninkrykskultuur (2): "Ken Hy Jou?"
episodes.desc: Jesus waarsku ons dat nie almal wat Hom as 'Here' bely aan Hom behoort nie. Slegs hulle wat die wil van die Vader doen is werklik deur Hom geken. Die vraag vir my en jou dus is: ken Hy my? Teks: Matteus 7:21-23 (AFR'83) Gasprediker: Johan du Toit Datum: 2 Augustus 2026

episodes.title: 378. Koninkrykskultuur (1): "Koninkryksbouprojek"
episodes.desc: Paulus beveel Timoteus en die gemeente om die ware lewe aan te gryp: deur die goeie belydenis van Jesus as die enigste Koning te onthou, én deur ryk te wees in goeie dade met die rykdom wat God gee. Teks: 1 Timoteus 6:12b-19 (ESV) Prediker: Johan Verster Datum: 26 Julie 2026

episodes.title: 377. Waarheid of Wolhaar? (3): “God sal jou nooit meer gee as wat jy kan hanteer nie”
episodes.desc: Die stelling “God sal jou nooit meer gee as wat jy kan hanteer nie” bevat elemente van waarheid: God is soewerein, getrou en laat Sy kinders nie alleen nie. Maar as dit beteken dat God belowe dat ons altyd genoeg krag in onsself sal hê om die lewe te dra, is dit oorhoofs wolhaar. Teks: 1 Konings 19:1-18 (AFR2020) Prediker: Dewald Wagner Datum: 19 Julie 2026

episodes.title: 376. Waarheid of Wolhaar? (2): "Jy Mag Nie Oordeel Nie"
episodes.desc: Jesus verbied nie alle oordeel nie. Hy verbied skynheilige oordeel. Sy dissipels moet eers hulleself ondersoek en bekeer voordat hulle ander aanspreek, en hulle primêre verantwoordelikheid is om mede-Christene in liefde verantwoordbaar te hou. Teks: Matteus 7:1-6; 1 Korintiërs 5 (AFR2020) Prediker: Johan Verster Datum: 12 Julie 2026

episodes.title: 375. Waarheid of Wolhaar? (1): "Alles Gebeur met 'n Rede? 'n Heroorweging van die Cliché"
episodes.desc: Selfs in die onbegryplikheid van lyding, is Christus ons versekering en ons troos. Teks: Romeine 8:26-30 (AFR2020) Prediker: Stephan Truter Datum: 5 Julie 2026

title: Cornerstone Church Johannesburg
author: Cornerstone Church Johannesburg
desc: Loving God. Loving Johannesburg.

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 20 September | Incomplete Surrender
episodes.desc: Are we fully surrendered to Jesus, by making Him Lord of our lives, or are there still areas in our lives that we want to hold on to and keep control for ourselves?

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 13 September | Choose this day
episodes.desc: Who will you serve? God wants a relationship with us, but he won't force us into that relationship, we have a choice to make.

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 6 September | Live like you remember
episodes.desc: We need to live and remember what Christ has done for us in our daily lives, as well as remember who we are in Him.

episodes.title: Kaleidoscope Women's Conference 2026 | Saturday 5 September | A love the world can see
episodes.desc: Taryn Herbert shares on kingdom friendships, living in unity, and loving one another like Christ loves us.

episodes.title: Kaleidoscope Women's Conference 2026 | Saturday 5 September | My Story
episodes.desc: Juliet Oppong is interviewed by Adele Herbert and shares some of her story on how faithful God has been, through the difficult and the good times.

episodes.title: Kaleidoscope Women's Conference 2026 | Friday 4 September | Trust the weaver
episodes.desc: Faith Hadebe shares on how we can always trust in God, because He created us, He knows us, He loves us and He has a plan for us.

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 30 August | Wholehearted faith
episodes.desc: Caleb wholeheartedly believed that God would do what He said He would do, even in Caleb's old age, he still had faith in God's promise.

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 23 August | Hidden compromise
episodes.desc: Our own Hidden compromises in our own life, don't only affect us, but they can change the lives of people around us for the negative. How we live in public should overflow from our private lives.Let us make sure we are living for Jesus even in the secret moments, when there is no one else around.

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 16 August | Remember what God has done
episodes.desc: Let us not forget what God has done in our lives and His faithfulness in our lives, because it is in remembering that we have faith for the next thing He is calling us to.

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 9 August | Consecrate yourselves
episodes.desc: God fulfills the promise, but He invites us to consecrate ourselves. We need to allow Him to prepare our hearts for what He is going to do.

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 2 August | Courage and obedience
episodes.desc: God has promises over our lives, but there are still acts of faith that we need to be obedient in, so that we can walk into those promises. What is God asking you to be obedient in, have courage for and what are the steps of faith that He is asking you to take?

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 26 July | Stay Faithful
episodes.desc: We start out new preaching series through Joshua and Judges, as we take a look at a generation who served God wholeheartedly, and somehow the generation to come after them didn't know God. What changed? What got lost? How can we be different?

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 19 July | Watchfulness
episodes.desc: We are called to be co labourers with Christ, following close behind Him, being watchful, looking for when we can assist Him.

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 5 July | Fruitfulness
episodes.desc: Are our lives fruitful and useful for the kingdom of God, or have we become like the fig tree in Mark 11 that gives no fruit?

episodes.title: Cornerstone Church Sunday Morning | 28 June | Worship
episodes.desc: Worship isn't just about singing, it is a lot more than that, worship is about intimacy with Jesus and allowing Him to minister into our lives. When we seek Him, He reveals himself to us.
